blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Rep. Raul Daza of the first district of Northern Samar has passed away at the age of 91. This was confirmed by his family on Thursday. Daza’s family said in a statement that the former lawmaker, who served the House of Representatives for seven terms between 1969 and 2019, peacefully passed away after more than five decades of public service. “It is with profound sadness that our family announces the passing of our beloved Raul Aguila Daza. He peacefully passed away at 91 years old. He was a devoted husband, loving father, grandfather, great-grandfather, son, brother, colleague, […]...
